# Collateral taxonomy (generated by scripts/export_taxonomy.py; do not edit by hand)

Source: `ontology/taxonomy_collateral.ttl` (DRAFT, to be reviewed against Acceptatiebeleid chapter 5). A property belongs to one class per **dimension**: e.g. a *regular house* (building type) that is *partly let* (use), a *project build* (construction) on *erfpacht* (legal right). Limits on a parent class apply to all its sub-classes; when several LTV norms apply, the **lowest** wins.

## Dimension: building type

- **dwelling on land** · *woning op het land* · `rabo:DwellingOnLand`
    - **apartment** · *appartement* · `rabo:Apartment` · AB-5.5.3  
      max LTV 100% with validated valuation report; 100% with value based on construction costs; 90% with desktop valuation (Calcasa); valuation: desktop valuation (Calcasa) / validated valuation report / value based on construction costs; interest-only allowed; letting allowed
    - **business dwelling** · *bedrijfswoning* · `rabo:BusinessDwelling`  
      max LTV 80%; interest-only **not allowed**
        - **business dwelling, private and business use** · *bedrijfswoning met bijbehorende (bedrijfs)opstallen en gronden: privé en zakelijk gebruik* · `rabo:BusinessDwellingMixedUse` · AB-5.5.8  
          valuation: valuation under the Rabobank business valuation policy
        - **business dwelling, private use only** · *bedrijfswoning met bijbehorende (bedrijfs)opstallen en gronden: privégebruik* · `rabo:BusinessDwellingPrivate` · AB-5.5.7  
          valuation: valuation report by an NRVT valuer (chamber LAV) with a plausibility statement / valuation under the Rabobank business valuation policy
    - **farmhouse** · *woonboerderij* · `rabo:Farmhouse`  
      letting allowed
        - **farmhouse with agricultural zoning, at most 3 ha** · *woonboerderij bestemming agrarisch en ≤ 3 HA* · `rabo:FarmhouseAgricultural` · AB-5.5.6  
          max LTV 100%; valuation: valuation report by an NRVT valuer (chamber LAV) with a plausibility statement; max 3 ha; no business use
        - **farmhouse with residential zoning** · *woonboerderij bestemming wonen of functieaanduiding* · `rabo:FarmhouseResidential` · AB-5.5.5  
          max LTV 100%; valuation: validated valuation report
    - **home with shop or practice** · *woon-/winkelpand of woon-/praktijkruimte* · `rabo:MixedUseProperty` · AB-5.5.4  
      max LTV 100% + 80% of the business part; valuation: validated valuation report; letting allowed
        - **home with practice** · *woon-/praktijkruimte* · `rabo:PracticeHouse`
        - **home with shop** · *woon-/winkelpand* · `rabo:ShopHouse`
    - **mobile home on a fixed pitch** · *woonwagen met vaste standplaats* · `rabo:MobileHome` · AB-5.5.10  
      max LTV 100%; valuation: validated valuation report; interest-only **not allowed**; **only with NHG**
    - **recreation home** · *recreatiewoning* · `rabo:RecreationHome` · AB-5.5.13  
      max LTV 90%; valuation: valuation report by an NRVT registered valuer; interest-only **not allowed**
    - **regular house** · *reguliere woning* · `rabo:RegularHouse` · AB-5.5.2  
      max LTV 100% with validated valuation report; 100% with value based on construction costs; 90% with desktop valuation (Calcasa); valuation: desktop valuation (Calcasa) / validated valuation report / value based on construction costs; interest-only allowed; letting allowed
- **dwelling on water** · *woning op het water* · `rabo:DwellingOnWater`
    - **houseboat** · *woonboot met vaste ligplaats* · `rabo:Houseboat` · AB-5.5.12  
      max LTV 90% + 90% of the mooring; valuation: valuation report by an E.M.C.I. certified houseboat valuer; interest-only **not allowed**; max term 30 years; mooring repaid in 20 years
    - **water home** · *waterwoning* · `rabo:WaterHome` · AB-5.5.11  
      max LTV 100%; valuation: validated valuation report; letting allowed
- **non-residential property** · *object zonder woonfunctie* · `rabo:NonResidentialProperty`
    - **other property with a business zoning** · *overige panden met zakelijke bestemming* · `rabo:OtherCommercialProperty` · AB-5.5.9  
      max LTV 80%; valuation: valuation under the Rabobank business valuation policy; interest-only **not allowed**; applicant must own a home financed by Rabobank
    - **standalone garage box** · *losse garagebox* · `rabo:StandaloneGarage` · AB-5.5.14  
      max LTV 90%; valuation: valuation report by an NRVT registered valuer; interest-only **not allowed**; **Plus conditions only**; applicant must own a home financed by Rabobank; max term 20 years

## Dimension: use

- **home for (partial) letting** · *woning voor (gedeeltelijke) verhuur* · `rabo:PartlyLetHome` · AB-5.5.15  
  max LTV 85%; valuation: validated valuation report; interest-only **not allowed**; **Plus conditions only**

    - **turnkey home** · *turnkey woning* · `rabo:TurnkeyBuild` · AB-5.5.1.2
